memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Hypothyroidism
  - Status: newly diagnosed, symptomatic with fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance.
  - Plan: start levothyroxine 50 mcg OD morning empty stomach; check TSH in 6 weeks; advise weight monitoring.
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: chronic abdominal bloating, alternating diarrhea/constipation, triggered by spicy food.
  - Plan: start mebeverine 135 mg BD before meals; ispaghula husk 5 g OD with water; advise low-FODMAP diet, regular meals.
- Migraine
  - Status: episodic headaches 2-3 per month, photophobia, nausea.
  - Plan: start propranolol 40 mg OD for prophylaxis; sumatriptan 50 mg SOS at aura; topiramate 25 mg HS; naproxen 500 mg SOS for breakthrough; maintain headache diary.
- General
  - Weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (above male cut‑off 90 cm).
  - Due: HbA1c not indicated; next TSH in 6 weeks; lipid profile annually.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Hypothyroidism
  - Status: persistent fatigue, TSH 6.5 mIU/L (above target), weight stable.
  - Plan: increase levothyroxine to 75 mcg OD morning empty stomach; recheck TSH in 6 weeks; reinforce adherence.
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: bloating improved with mebeverine and ispaghula; occasional loose stools after heavy meals.
  - Plan: continue current regimen; add loperamide 2 mg SOS for diarrhea if needed; advise food diary.
- Migraine
  - Status: headache frequency reduced to 1‑2 per month; propranolol well tolerated.
  - Plan: maintain propranolol 40 mg OD; keep sumatriptan SOS; topiramate 25 mg HS; naproxen SOS.
- General
  - Weight 77 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off).
  - Due: next TSH in 6 weeks; lipid profile annually.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Hypothyroidism
  - Status: TSH 3.8 mIU/L (target), patient euthyroid, weight 75 kg.
  - Plan: continue levothyroxine 100 mcg OD; repeat TSH in 3 months.
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: increased diarrhea episodes (2‑3/week) after street food; abdominal cramping.
  - Plan: reinforce loperamide SOS; consider rifaximin course if symptoms persist; advise avoidance of high‑fat meals.
- Migraine
  - Status: stable, 1 headache/month; topiramate 25 mg HS causing mild paresthesia.
  - Plan: reduce topiramate to 12.5 mg HS; monitor; keep propranolol 40 mg OD.
- General
  - Weight 75 kg, waist 86 cm.
  - Due: next TSH in 3 months; lipid profile next year.
